keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! AC Milan 1, Inter Milan 0. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Diego Moreira with a cross.
Goal! AC Milan 2, Inter Milan 0. Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Diego Moreira following a corner.
Goal! AC Milan 2, Inter Milan 1. Alessandro Bastoni (Inter Milan) header from very close range to the centre of the goal following a corner.
Goal! AC Milan 3, Inter Milan 1. Diego Moreira (AC Milan) from a free kick with a left footed shot to the top right corner.
First Half ends, AC Milan 3, Inter Milan 1.
Second Half begins AC Milan 3, Inter Milan 1.
Koni De Winter (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Diego Moreira (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Piotr Zielinski replaces Hakan Çalhanoglu.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Henrikh Mkhitaryan replaces Andy Diouf.
Delay in match because of an injury Yann Bisseck (Inter Milan).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Federico Dimarco replaces Alessandro Bastoni.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Francesco Pio Esposito replaces Nicolò Barella.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Ange-Yoan Bonny replaces Yann Bisseck.
Substitution, AC Milan. Ardon Jashari replaces Yunus Musah.
Substitution, AC Milan. Alphadjo Cisse replaces Christian Pulisic.
Substitution, AC Milan. Davide Bartesaghi replaces Sankhoun Diawara.
Substitution, AC Milan. Filippo Terracciano replaces Gonçalo Ramos.
Substitution, AC Milan. Omari Hutchinson replaces Diego Moreira.
Carlos Augusto (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, AC Milan 3, Inter Milan 1.
